scenario_kind: synthetic benchmark reconstructed from the original assistant-reviewed probe; no real buyer constraints supplied
buyer_context: Mid-size Indian 3PL evaluating logistics visibility/integration and AI workflow claims

requirements.question: Which current product, SKU and contracting route serves a new mid-size Indian 3PL: project44, LSP44 or another offering? Reconcile current API and security scope before judging fit.

Does the offered product document a unified multi-mode shipment-tracking API? Inspect authentication, regional hosts/sandbox, webhook retry/error semantics, duplicates, timeouts, queue expiry, idempotency and category-specific rate limits. Actual buyer lane coverage and runtime behavior remain untested.

What evidence supports historical Girteka use, and what current comparable customer deployment can be established? Preserve product, date, region and relationship attribution; do not infer a direct project44-Asendia contract through Girteka.
What AI agents and configurable workflows are described and released? Distinguish dated release evidence from tenant entitlement, successful execution, approval controls and recovery behavior.
What supports the claim of 85% faster exception resolution? Seek cohort, baseline, metric definition, distribution and comparability before using it in ROI.

What SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 assurances are listed for Movement or the offered product? Separate trust-center labels from reviewed in-scope reports, certificate validity, audit periods and exceptions.

What public evidence describes cloud architecture, GKE/Kubernetes, multi-region/cloud operations and infrastructure cost claims? Attribute Cast AI supplier testimony and distinguish an initial-cluster saving from whole-company savings.

What dependencies and processing roles are disclosed, including hosting and generative-AI providers? Check SKU-specific regional flows, retention and training-use questions; do not infer proprietary model ownership, false AI claims or that all data reaches all subprocessors.

checks.instruction: Resolve vendor/domain/product/business identity before dependent conclusions; old customer/security evidence does not automatically transfer across the project44/LSP44 boundary.
Preserve the five original claim areas (API, Girteka, agents, 85% outcome, security); additional fit/dependency questions do not replace them.
Read original relevant documents and exact passages; snippets, badges and vendor repetition are not independent verification.
Check requested/returned URL, body relevance, truncation and login/challenge state. Preserve retrieval conflicts, including Girteka recruiting redirects; do not treat HTTP 200 as usable evidence.
Keep publication, modification, release/event, record-refresh and retrieval dates distinct. Relevant post-2026-09-01 events need actual dated evidence, not a recent retrieval timestamp.

Deduplicate source origins/content; two Girteka articles are one customer origin. Historical use does not establish a current contract, Indian coverage, new AI adoption or a direct Asendia relationship.
Preserve exact mode/version-specific webhook failure and category rate-limit rules; do not generalize all server errors as retryable or one rate to all endpoints.

Every question gets support limited to its scope or cannot verify, with missing evidence, supplier questions and a reproducible pilot. No supplier approval, falsehood verdict, proprietary-IP determination or security certification.
Buyer sets lane mix, workloads, integrations, thresholds, budget and timing. Keep these missing until supplied; research acceptance criteria are not invented commercial must-haves.
Enforce budgets, visible operations, returned charges, durable history and source provenance. Retain an HTML/JSON dossier; no outreach, operational vendor API tests, accounts or deployment.
Keep customer corroboration and professional/timeline investigation in the complete benchmark as pending branches; vendor-only review cannot claim they ran.
This historical public probe is not a current ground-truth answer key. Reacquire evidence for live runs, separate stale/reference expectations, and do not hardcode project44 facts into the agent.

Customer/professional branches are enabled read-only; record coverage for both with actual operation IDs. Statements support only their stated relationship, product, time and role scope, never verification, a current contract or buying intent. Report explicit gaps when access, evidence or budget stops work; no fixed source/person quota.

Target integrations, deployment/data constraints and workload/scale
Buyer pass/fail thresholds and baseline metrics
output: HTML requirements/claim matrix with exact source passages, evidence status, independent-verification limits and verification plan; retain source/cost dossier
